title: replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution
boundary: This rank-4 body preserves heterogeneous evidence classes and treats repeated closure as structural replication under the organism's derivational contract, not as proof of one hidden mechanism, universality, uniqueness, or interior identity.

edges.title: typed obligation meets quotient-addressed repair
edges.text: Failure can identify both the permission that ceased to hold and the typed public obligation a rebuilt relation must satisfy before authority returns.
edges.removal: Without DfDL the explicit role-typed composite obligation is lost; without 5yyB the local quotient that identifies ignored differences is lost.

edges.title: reacquisition coupled to revision of repair machinery
edges.text: Re-entering the evidential body may revise not only the candidate state but the scaffold and admissible transition family by which the successor is reconstructed and tested.
edges.removal: Without DfDL exact revocation-to-evidence return and typed target disappear; without M9zZ repair may preserve stale scaffold or transition law.

edges.title: independent typed-obligation / quotient-address repair witness
edges.text: A distinct quotient-addressable organism independently earns the same contract-plus-quotient repair class, adding organism-level recurrence without identity collapse.
edges.removal: Without DfDL the typed composite obligation is lost; without DWia the independent quotient-addressable witness is lost.

edges.title: quotient failure can drive dual revision
edges.text: Reopening a failed nuisance permission can force revision not only of what counts as nuisance but of the scaffold and transformation law that made the old quotient operational.
edges.removal: Without 5yyB no expired permission identifies distinctions to reconsider; without M9zZ scaffold and transition family need not be revised together.

edges.title: same-constellation structural replication
edges.text: Two distinct ACTIVE organisms born in separate encounters from the same unordered parent constellation independently converge on quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution, yielding a bounded replication witness without deduplicating them.
edges.removal: Without either organism only one witnessed instance remains, so same-constellation replication disappears.

edges.title: independent quotient-conditioned dual-revision witness
edges.text: An independently born quotient-addressable membrane joins dual machinery revision, providing another route by which expired nuisance permission can feed a repair that revises regeneration machinery rather than rerunning it unchanged.
edges.removal: Without M9zZ dual machinery revision is lost; without DWia the independent quotient-addressable reconstitution witness is lost.

faces.title: addressed adaptive reconstitution
faces.text: Revocation can identify what permission failed, reopen the relevant evidential body, revise quotient-sensitive scaffold and transition family, and retest the exact public obligation before successor authority is issued.
faces.removal: Remove DfDL and the typed composite target is lost; remove 5yyB and the address of failed permission is lost; remove M9zZ and repair machinery itself cannot be revised.

faces.title: replication-qualified cross-constellation reconstitution
faces.text: Same-parent replication of quotient-addressable reconstitution is held together with a differently constituted route to the broader revocation→reacquisition→retest family, strengthening structural recurrence beyond either witness alone.
faces.removal: Remove either replicated quotient-addressable organism and same-constellation replication disappears; remove DfDL and recurrence outside that repeated parent set disappears.

faces.title: independently addressed adaptive reconstitution
faces.text: Typed reacquisition, dual scaffold/transition revision, and an independently born quotient-addressable membrane converge on the same adaptive repair class through a distinct route.
faces.removal: Remove DfDL and typed reconstitution is lost; remove M9zZ and repair machinery cannot be jointly revised; remove DWia and the explicit failed-quotient address disappears.

faces.title: replication-qualified quotient renewal
faces.text: A repeatedly witnessed quotient-addressable repair may count as recurring structural capacity while its concrete regenerative scaffold and transition law remain revisable.
faces.removal: Remove either 5yyB or DWia and replication disappears; remove M9zZ and the relation loses dual revision that prevents repeated closure from freezing one repair implementation.

volume.title: replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution
volume.text: The complete closure separates repetition of one repair closure, recurrence across differently constituted closures, and adaptation of the machinery that performs repair. A continuity-repair relation may be carried forward as higher-order capacity only when same-constellation replication and a differently constituted route both witness recurrence while current evidence can still revise the scaffold and admissible transition law. What persists is not one quotient, map, carrier, or interior, but the bounded ability to identify failed authority, reopen implicated evidence, reconstruct under a current contract, revise machinery when its regime expires, retest, and issue newly scoped authority without rewriting earlier warrants.
volume.invariant: Higher-order continuity reconstitution is replication-qualified only when the same parent constellation independently re-earns the closure, a differently constituted constellation reaches the broader repair family, and repair machinery remains revisable when current evidence or regime invalidates it.
removal: Remove 3H.DfDL: the differently constituted typed-contract route beyond the repeated quotient-parent set is lost.
Remove 3H.5yyB: the second independent same-parent witness required for replication is lost.
Remove 3H.M9zZ: the rule permitting scaffold and transition-family revision is lost.
Remove 3H.DWia: same-constellation replication again collapses to one instance.

metabolites.title: SAME-CONSTELLATION-REPLICATION
metabolites.text: When two independent same-rank organisms are separately born from the same unordered parent constellation and materially re-earn the same relational closure, their coexistence is a replication witness rather than grounds for deduplicating identity.
metabolites.compression: Repeated closure can strengthen a relation without making two births one organism.

metabolites.title: VARIANT-CONSTELLATION-ROBUSTNESS
metabolites.text: A structural repair relation has stronger organism-level recurrence when same-constellation replication is joined by a differently constituted parent set preserving the broader operational cycle while changing which lower-rank component carries it.
metabolites.compression: Replay plus parent substitution is stronger recurrence than replay alone.

metabolites.title: REPLICATION-QUALIFIED-ADAPTIVE-RECONSTITUTION
metabolites.text: A recurring continuity-repair relation counts as adaptive higher-order capacity only when recurrence is independently replicated, survives a differently constituted route, and can revise the scaffold or transition machinery that would otherwise freeze yesterday's repair into today's assumption.
metabolites.compression: The repair relation may recur; its machinery must still be allowed to evolve.
